trust_decision.summary: Request-supplied bidder params (imp.ext.bidder host/subdomain-like fields) are trusted as a bare host label when substituted into the authority of an adapter's outbound endpoint URL; nothing decides they contain no '/', '?', '#', '@' or scheme, neither in the JSON-schema layer (static/bidder-params) nor in each adapter's URL builder.

landing_point.why: The summary says request forgery to host environment; an engineer would look at how bidder endpoints are templated from request params (ResolveMacros) and then at the most obvious adapter with http://{{.Host}}/ (zeroclickfraud).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Rediads does not use the {{.Host}} template mechanism the report points at, and the JSON schemas are 'just documentation/validation', so a solver who centralises a check in the macro path or in adapters only can argue both are outside the templating flaw.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate values must keep working: relevantdigital pbsHost given as 'https://foo.relevant-digital.com' (normalised before use), tradplus empty zoneId, host:port for Host-type fields, mixed case and 'localhost'; but no port for adhese/kayzen/tradplus/rediads label-only fields. An over-broad fix (reject any scheme, or reject empty, or one pattern for all) breaks these.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Host goes into http://{{.Host}}.betweendigital.com with only a non-empty check in Go; protection rests solely on the schema enum, so dropping or widening the enum in our copy yields a realistic unfixed sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Schema enum and Go code are separate files; a maintainer adding a new region could relax the enum to a free string as silvermob.json already is.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Hard-coded host allowlist could plausibly be replaced by a format check or a pass-through when adding regions.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: silvermob.json:11-14 already accepts any string for host; only the Go allowlist protects it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Region into http://{{.Region}}.clydo.io with only a schema enum (static/bidder-params/clydo.json:13-16); relaxing it is a realistic sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Default-region fallback in Go code suggests regions are expected to grow.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Route URL parsed from request; region derived from hostname against an allowlist; a realistic variant would take Hostname() directly.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The adapter already parses an attacker-supplied full URL; using its host directly is a one-line simplification.

out_of_scope_notes: Path- and query-position params (e.g. /openrtb/{{.PublisherID}}?host={{.Host}} in many bidder-info templates) are unvalidated but cannot change the authority; not pursued.
